children: Scribe Therapeutics, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of $1.92M and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $6.48M, or diluted loss per share of $(2.62). Revenue fell sharply year‑over‑year due to reduced reimbursable collaboration activity, while the company narrowed its loss versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $1.918M for Q2 2026, down from $4.898M in the year‑ago quarter (‑61% YoY).
Net income (net loss attributable to common stockholders) was $(6.477M) for Q2 2026, improved from a $(9.903M) loss in the year‑ago quarter (loss narrowed 35% YoY).
Diluted earnings per share was $(2.62) for Q2 2026, versus $(4.08) in the year‑ago quarter.
Clinical milestone: Initiated first‑in‑human Phase 1 trial of STX‑1150 aimed at durable LDL‑C reduction following a single administration.
Preclinical momentum: Presented nonhuman primate data showing up to ~90% PCSK9 suppression and ~68% LDL‑C reduction, with durable >50% LDL‑C reduction at 0.75 mg/kg for two years.
Pipeline expansion: Advancing XE‑based programs STX‑1200 (Lp(a) editing) and STX‑1400 (APOC3/triglyceride disorders); awarded a CIRM grant of approximately $25.7M.
Collaboration shift: Reduced revenue and R&D activity with Lilly and Sanofi versus the prior year; collaborations continue to provide non‑dilutive funding and validation.
Operational guidance: Company expects cash runway (including IPO proceeds) to fund operations into H1 2029 and plans to scale clinical, manufacturing, and regulatory capabilities.
